method: Visually inspected every original native-resolution 1440x1000 Minecraft framebuffer PNG using view_image; no image editing or resampling.
scope: 25 staged structure frames only; natural terrain and crops reviewed separately.
limitations: Structure scenes are disposable staged placement fixtures, not evidence of natural terrain integration.
Four spider pocket chests are partially clipped while full resident and room subjects remain clear.
Porch item sprites are a documented staged replay artifact, confirmed by saved-world item IDs and the vanilla chest/template placement code; no unsupported decoration was found.
Wither exterior replacement is a close roof view beneath a native upper-gallery ceiling. Natural fog softens rear roofs; it complements rather than replaces the four-center geometry test.

frames.observation: Entry, native icicles, snow floor tiers, residents, both chests and spawner visible.

frames.label: wither-exterior
frames.observation: Primary structure is obscured by natural foreground terrain and cyan fog. Reject this angle; close oblique retake requested.

frames.label: wither-entry
frames.observation: Obsidian entrance and tunnel are clearly readable. Natural teal vegetation remains in staged fixture but does not block passage.

frames.label: wither-pocket-1
frames.observation: Full skeleton, complete foreground chest and connecting room visible; distant entities readable through natural fog.

frames.label: wither-pocket-2
frames.observation: Full magma cubes, complete chest and connecting room visible.

frames.label: wither-boss
frames.observation: Whole Wither, helpers and closed chamber readable. Chest partially overlapped by helper, not clipped by frame.

frames.label: orc-exterior
frames.observation: Front curved palisade and foreground houses readable, but distant half fades into fog. Omit this angle from selected gallery; full-compound is the clear overview.

frames.label: orc-full-compound
frames.observation: All six houses, two pens, two crop plots, gate, courtyard and entire curved palisade visible with margin. Animals are beyond entity draw distance here and verified in dedicated pen views.

frames.label: orc-courtyard
frames.observation: Central path, campfire, crop plots and surrounding native-style houses readable; scene provides ground-level context.

frames.label: orc-native-large-house
frames.observation: Entire decorated large house and roof horns framed; resident and one interior chest visible. Porch item sprites are camp loot dropped by deliberate QA template replay, confirmed by orc-staged-item-audit.json; all nine chests and their acacia-plank supports remain intact.

frames.label: orc-native-small-house
frames.observation: Complete small-house rear exterior, native roof shape and white roof ornament framed. This angle does not show its entrance or interior chest.

frames.label: orc-sheep-pen
frames.observation: Complete closed pen with exactly three visible sheep, hay and recessed water; palisade, skull posts and bushes visible behind.

frames.label: orc-boar-pen
frames.observation: Complete closed pen with exactly three visible boars, hay and recessed water; palisade and bushes visible behind.

frames.label: orc-irrigated-crops
frames.observation: Both mature crop plots and central irrigation channels clear, together with campfire, paths and houses.

frames.label: orc-curved-palisade
frames.observation: Curved logs, taller fence posts, skulls and leaf bushes readable in close perspective; adjacent sheep pen visible.

frames.label: wither_exterior_close_oblique
frames.observation: Replacement angle below native upper-gallery floor clearly shows foreground obsidian roof and side-room outer contours. No isolated one-block nub is visible on foreground roof. Distant roof centers are softened by native cyan fog; this frame alone does not visually prove removal at all four centers. Saved-world roof geometry audit and passing regression cover all four.

acceptance: All 24 selected structure frames passed review. Two weak original angles are excluded; the accepted replacement is included without editing image bytes.
